notes.title: WildFire Update 01
notes.content:
This update mainly focus on bug fix and 

Things already done:
· Make changes to the weaknesses of all characters, now each character has only one weakness, and diseases are no longer included; This means even if a negative effect lasts for some time, it won't affect too many characters
· Fix bugs in events (certain events should not be repeated)
· Balanced some props and events, increased the appearance rate of certain props (such as mushrooms), and modified the requirements of certain events
·Fixed some issues where the text did not match the actual effect

What will definitely be done next:
· Add new achievements
· Balance adjustment between events and props

Things might be done in the future: 
· At the end of the day, if there is a dying state (fire, hunger, disease), a info will be given to remind players

Thanks to all the players who have supported this game. I am not doing well enough and will continue to make better games in the future

And the new work is in preparation——
